DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_GoldenHorse:
During the golden age of alchemy on the island, 
its ever-glowing golden fur was highly prized as a catalyst for transmuting gold.
Sometimes drops Feybreak materials when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_MysteryMask:
The mask it wears is not its face, they say.
It seems in front, but it's not there, no way.
From shadows deep, it watches night and day.
Glance away, and closer it will stray.

Sometimes drops Feybreak materials when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_WhiteShieldDragon:
The metallic components around its neck possess magnetic properties.
If the leg pieces get too close, they cling to it.
When metal debris builds up on its neck, it grudgingly begins cleaning, 
and grows frustrated when they won't come off easily.

Sometimes drops Feybreak materials when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_BlackPuppy:
The black flames are merely warm to the touch, 
but anything left in contact with them slowly melts from the inside. 
Hold some cheese over them, and it becomes a true delicacy.

Sometimes drops Feybreak materials when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_BlackPuppy_Ice:
The blue flames are merely cool to the touch, 
but anything left in contact with them slowly freezes.
Hold a milk bottle over them, and you get a frozen milkshake!

Sometimes drops Feybreak materials when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_NightBlueHorse:
It takes great pride in its flowing, gorgeous mane.
If it finds a split end, it becomes so mortified it can't focus on running properly. 
Because static electricity makes its hair frizzy, it avoids <characterName id=|BlueThunderHorse|/> at all costs.

Sometimes drops Feybreak materials when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_NightBlueHorse_Neutral:
It takes great pride in its glowing, gorgeous mane.
If it gets even slightly dirty, it becomes so mortified 
it can't focus on running properly. 
Because skin oils ruin its coat, it wants to avoid being touched too much,
even by its favorite Pal Tamer.

Sometimes drops Feybreak materials when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.

DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_GoldenHorse:
Can be ridden.
Changes the player's attack type to <uiCommon id=|COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Earth|/> while mounted.
Sometimes drops Feybreak materials when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_MysteryMask:
While in party, 
increases Party Pals' <Status_Keyword>EXP gained</> by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

Sometimes drops Feybreak materials when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_WhiteShieldDragon:
Can be ridden. 

While in party, 
reduces shield regeneration delay by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> and reduces damage taken by your shield by <Status_Up>{Passive2_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

Sometimes drops Feybreak materials when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_BlackPuppy:
When activated, 
uses its sharp sense of smell to detect nearby <itemName id=|Chromium| style=|Status_Keyword|/>. 

While fighting together, 
<itemName id=|Chromium| style=|Status_Keyword|/> acquisition increases by <Status_Up>+{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>.

Sometimes drops Feybreak materials when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_BlackPuppy_Ice:
While at a base, 
increases the <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_Cool| style=|Status_Keyword|/> Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by <Status_Keyword>+{Passive1_EffectValue1}</>.
(Does not stack)

Sometimes drops Feybreak materials when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_NightBlueHorse:
Can be ridden. 
Boosts jumping ability while mounted.

This Pal's movement speed increases by <Status_Up>+{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> at night.

Sometimes drops Feybreak materials when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_NightBlueHorse_Neut: Can be ridden. Boosts Jump Power while mounted. This Pal’s Movement Speed increases by {Passive1_EffectValue1}% for each other Pal in your party. (Excluding ) Sometimes drops Feybreak materials when assigned to .
